name: Carbon Mapper Tanager source-level null-detect supplement
research_question: Can authoritative production-phase Tanager source-scene null detections provide at least 28 leakage-safe Sentinel-2 L1C or Landsat 8/9 Level-1 negative pairs without recycling MARS-S2L geography?

decision_context_disclosed_before_freeze.anti_pooling_boundary: Carbon Mapper must pass every metadata gate and later contribute at least 28 qualifying target pairs by itself. It may supplement the already-qualified MARS-Hyperspectral cohort only after doing so; it may not pool with STARCOP, CACH4, COVID, Permian, or another failed candidate to satisfy a gate.

license_contract.permitted_scope: Non-commercial research to improve greenhouse-gas emissions monitoring, reporting, or mitigation.
obligations: attribute Carbon Mapper in the paper, data documentation, and any derivative release
redistribute Carbon Mapper data or derivative products only under the same or substantially similar non-commercial and attribution terms
do not represent a null detect as proof of physical zero methane
do not use Carbon Mapper data or derivatives commercially without a separate license
license_contract.checkpoint_boundary: Any distributed model checkpoint materially trained on these labels must be marked non-commercial, attributed to Carbon Mapper, and share-alike under the applicable Carbon Mapper terms.

candidate_filter_before_detail_requests: feature geometry is a finite WGS84 Point
properties.source_name encodes a 100m source with coordinates agreeing with the feature point
properties.observation_scenes_names is a non-empty unique string list
source_selection.overflow_action: If more than 1000 source features qualify, request only the first 1000 by the frozen order and report truncation; do not choose by geography, emissions, MARS distance, or model output.

required_source_response: source_name and WGS84 point agree with the requested source
daily_breakdown and top-level scene identities are internally consistent
required_annotated_scene: UUID and name match the authoritative source response
bounds are finite WGS84 and contain the source point
authoritative_null_contract.scene_wide_plume_count_note: A scene may contain a plume at another source. The negative label is source-crop-specific and comes only from counts_as_null_detection=true for that source-scene pair; published_plume_count is not used to create or reject the label.
authoritative_null_contract.claim: No Carbon Mapper detection above the applicable Tanager sensitivity at the reviewed source in that qualifying scene; not physical zero methane.

deterministic_row_selection.selection_timing: after authoritative null and scene-schema validation, before MARS distance filtering or target-catalog access

exclude_if_within_radius_of: any official MARS-S2L test representative location
any already-counted MARS-Hyperspectral negative source crop
eligibility.novel_component_requirement: Every member of a counted component must be strictly farther than 25 km from every MARS-S2L representative location.
eligibility.grouping: Transitive connected components of retained source points with an undirected edge at haversine distance <=25.0 km.

gates.population: Deterministically selected authoritative null pairs after official-test and prior-negative exclusions; the component gate additionally requires every member to be >25 km from every MARS-S2L representative.

failure_action: Retire the Carbon Mapper supplement without changing a threshold, querying a target catalog, or pooling another failed candidate source.
pass_action: Commit a separate target-catalog protocol before any Sentinel-2 or Landsat query.
forbidden_content: Carbon Mapper RGB, atmospheric retrieval, plume raster, concentration tile, or other image asset
any target Sentinel-2/Landsat catalog or asset
any EMIT, AVIRIS-NG, AVIRIS-3, GAO, SSC, Tanager first-light, CO2, unassessed, or >25%-cloud row
claim_boundary: A pass would establish licensed, source-level Tanager null-detect metadata feasibility only. It would not prove physical zero methane, coincident Sentinel-2/Landsat yield, cross-sensor validity, model complementarity, calibration, or superiority over MARS-S2L.
